card.name: Digits inside section numbers and ranges
card.fires_on: A single digit that ends or continues a number such as a section reference (2.4, 10.2), a volume or year (1912), or a numeric range in a table.

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: Last digit of a section number in a parenthetical list of cross-references.

modes.label: Table ranges and years
modes.description: A digit inside a numeric range or a year in a list or table.

modes.label: Numbered series
modes.description: A digit in a numbered item such as a volume or a device label.

card.plain: It fires on the digits inside section numbers, year lists and table ranges.
